user_query: I need to analyze the advanced chart image for the symbol 'DOGEUSDTPERP' with studies set to 'MACD' and 'Bollinger Bands'. Please generate the image in PNG format with a dark theme and a width of 800 pixels. Also, provide me with a mini chart image for the same symbol and interval set to '1M' with a height of 400 pixels.

TaskList.description: Fetch advanced chart data for the symbol 'DOGEUSDTPERP' with MACD and Bollinger Bands studies.
Generate a PNG image of the advanced chart using the fetched data, ensuring it has a dark theme and a width of 800 pixels.
Fetch mini chart data for the symbol 'DOGEUSDTPERP' with an interval set to '1M'.
Generate a mini chart image using the fetched mini chart data, ensuring it has a height of 400 pixels.
